findingNotFixed.summary: Switching the UI language from Japanese to English and back invalidated an otherwise current preflight snapshot; the status changed to the stale message even though the model inputs were not edited.
observed: JP current report: 入力版: 11 / 現在の入力と一致

findingNotFixed.whyNotFixed: The snapshot identity is supplied by main.js wiring (project + currentAnalysisOptions), which this work order marks read-only. Excluding a language field inside the preflight UI would be a workaround and could mask real input changes.
findingNotFixed.followUp: Check whether api.exportProject() or currentAnalysisOptions() contains locale-dependent state and exclude it from the preflight identity in a separately approved main.js change.

independentReviewAnnotation.classification: Observed locale-triggered report invalidation is explicitly implemented existing behavior; the proposed main.js snapshot-identity cause is unproven.
independentReviewAnnotation.sourceEvidence: src/ui/analysis-preflight-ui.js explicitly registers doc.addEventListener?.('studio-language',invalidate). The existing test named 'locale event clears dynamic diagnostics instead of retaining an old-language report' asserts this behavior.
independentReviewAnnotation.scope: The observed stale message does not prove project or options identity changed. Do not exclude locale fields from identity based on this observation alone.
independentReviewAnnotation.followUp: If changing the locale UX is desired, first define whether to clear, rerun or translate the report while retaining stale-input protection. This is a separate behavior decision, not a confirmed main.js defect.
